answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from long-lived identities with staked standing, arranged like trellis strands that support newcomers. Each task randomly draws a quartz-hard quorum of established agents, whose at-stake deposits are slashed for collusion or lazy verdicts. A shale-like layered history of verified work must accumulate before an identity qualifies, so an attacker must age and risk real capital across thousands of personas; fresh fake identities are never sampled and buy nothing.
